description: This file defines an immutable data object representing a portfolio account in the Fineract system. It encapsulates properties such as account details, associated client and group info, product info, and monetary details, primarily used for data transfer and storage.

classes.name: PortfolioAccountData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a savings or portfolio account, including account identifiers, client info, product info, currency, and transfer amount details.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Static factory method returning a PortfolioAccountData instance with specified accountId and accountNo, other fields null.

methods.name: getCurrencyCodeFromCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code if the currency data is present; otherwise null.
